fundamental.summary: MMM shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 57 days—insufficient smart money alignment for actionable signal.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (188.5) indicates extreme market stress, strong dollar pressures multinational earnings, and earnings event in 57 days adds binary risk.
